bug_report.id: Admin write action cards display weak result and refresh too little data
bug_report.text:
Title: Admin write action cards display weak result and refresh too little data

Area: frontend_ai_chat_v2

Observed behavior:
Stage 6 admin write cards reused the shared action card, but the frontend treated only admin email drafts as admin drafts.
Confirmed admin write results could display low-value raw result fields before the human-readable executor message.
After confirming an admin write, only a narrow set of query keys was invalidated, so affected admin pages such as assets, teams, planning, recruitment, outflow, or notifications could remain stale.

Expected behavior:
Any `admin_*` action draft should render as an admin action card.
Executed action result text should prioritize the safe human-readable message and useful display fields.
Confirmed admin writes should invalidate related frontend query caches for the modules that the write can affect.

extra_context.leakage_note: Fix commit metadata and ground truth are for evaluation only.

stack_trace:
Admin write cards did not consistently show admin-specific treatment.

Confirm mutation invalidated chat, employee, auth, and leave queries only, leaving several admin module views potentially stale.

bug_report.id: Handbook QA retrieves weak excerpts or routes statutory leave as profile data
bug_report.text:
Title: Handbook QA retrieves weak excerpts or routes statutory leave as profile data

Area: chatbot_v2
HR knowledge Q&A / handbook retrieval

Observed behavior:
Valid handbook questions could return an unresolved answer even though `Company_Handbook_English.docx` contains the answer.
What are the working hours at Capisoft?` retrieved generic handbook foreword/general-obligation excerpts and answered that no reliable working-hours answer was available.
How do I report sick?` retrieved a personal-data/report-sick mention instead of the `Article 11.1 Calling in sick` section and answered that no reliable reporting process was available.
How many statutory vacation days do I get?` was classified as a self profile/leave-balance style question instead of HR policy Q&A, so it could bypass the dedicated handbook answer path and fall back to generic agent behavior.
Natural paraphrases such as `When should I be at my desk?`, `How many hours do full-time employees work?`, and `What should I do if I am ill?` were initially missed or retrieved weak handbook snippets even after the base working-hours/sick questions were fixed.
During real smoke testing, OpenSearch also returned a 403 permission error, so the local document fallback path became the effective retrieval path.

Expected behavior:
Handbook policy/process questions should route to HR knowledge Q&A.
Policy-scoped leave prompts using words such as `statutory`, `legal`, or `legally` should stay in HR knowledge Q&A.
When OpenSearch is unavailable or unauthorized, local fallback retrieval should select the best matching handbook section, not the first weak keyword occurrence.
Valid handbook questions should answer from the handbook and only use the generic `contact HR` escalation when the available sources are genuinely missing or weak.

bug_report.text:
Title: Local/staging chatbot LLM calls fail with Bedrock InvokeModel access denied

Area: chatbot_v2
admin_agent
environment_aws_bedrock

Observed behavior:
Local Admin Chatbot V2 sessions against staging config showed `Session error` or `timeout of 15000ms exceeded`.
RAG source snippets could still appear, but final answers were unreliable or fell back to generic "could not find a reliable answer" responses.
The first suspicion was a local `staging.yaml`, Firebase, VPN, or frontend issue.
A teammate later confirmed the configured inference profile came from the wrong AWS account.

Expected behavior:
With staging config loaded and network access available, the backend should be able to invoke the configured Bedrock model/profile and generate a normal chatbot answer from retrieved context.

excluded_ground_truth_entries: AWS IAM role/profile configuration for `opensearch-bedrock` and the configured Bedrock application inference profile
extra_context.leakage_note: Fix commit metadata and ground truth are for evaluation only.

What is our remote work policy?

how does zero contract get their paid?
